name: Cisco Firepower — IPS Event with Critical Severity (v2)
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_firepower_raw
| filter cefDeviceEventClassId ~= "^INTRUSION:400:" and to_integer(cefSeverity) >= 9
| alter attacker_ip = src, attacker_port = spt, victim_ip = dst, victim_port = dpt
| alter signature = cefName, fw_rule = cs2, ips_policy = cs5, ips_rule_id = cs6, threat_category = cat
| fields attacker_ip, attacker_port, victim_ip, victim_port, app, dvchost, cefDeviceEventClassId, cefSeverity, act, signature, fw_rule, ips_rule_id, threat_category, cs3, cs4, requestClientApplication
description: Snort/FTD intrusion event at CEF severity >= 9. Replaces rule 72, which filtered cefName = "Intrusion Detected" - a value neither Cisco nor this tenant produces. Intrusion events are matched on the eNcore signature ID prefix INTRUSION:400: because eNcore names each event after its Snort rule message; the signature is read from cefName, and cs2 is the access-control rule (fwRule) that passed the flow to the intrusion policy. Direction corrected: src is the external attacker, dst the internal victim.
alert_name: Cisco Firepower — IPS Event with Critical Severity (v2)
